tasks.title: Install Required NuGet Packages
tasks.description: Add SharpCompress, BCnEncoder.Net, and GdUnit4Net packages to the DMapGodot.csproj file for archive handling, DDS texture conversion, and testing support. Implements Phase 1: Project Setup, Section 4.1 from PRD (lines 114-135).
tasks.details:
Update DMapGodot.csproj to include comprehensive PackageReference entries as specified in PRD lines 115-134. This replaces SevenZipSharp (mentioned in PRD line 106) with SharpCompress for archive handling and adds DDS texture conversion capabilities via BCnEncoder.Net. Also includes GdUnit4Net testing framework setup.

**Complete csproj content (PRD lines 115-134):**
```xml
<Project Sdk="Godot.NET.Sdk/4.4.0">
  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>
    <EnableDynamicLoading>true</EnableDynamicLoading>
    <RootNamespace>DMapImporter</RootNamespace>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="SharpCompress" Version="0.38.0" />
    <PackageReference Include="BCnEncoder.Net" Version="2.1.0" />
    <!-- Testing -->
    <PackageReference Include="gdUnit4.api" Version="5.0.0" />
    <PackageReference Include="gdUnit4.test.adapter" Version="3.0.0" />
    <PackageReference Include="gdUnit4.analyzers" Version="1.0.0">
      <PrivateAssets>all</PrivateAssets>
      <IncludeAssets>runtime; build; native; contentfiles; analyzers</IncludeAssets>
    </PackageReference>
  </ItemGroup>
</Project>
```

**Package Dependencies Context:**
- SharpCompress v0.38.0: Replaces SevenZipSharp for .7z/.dmap archive handling (PRD line 124)
- BCnEncoder.Net v2.1.0: DDS texture conversion for game assets (PRD line 125)
- GdUnit4Net packages: Testing framework for Godot C# projects (PRD lines 127-133)

**Post-installation commands:**
1. `dotnet restore` - Install dependencies
2. `dotnet build` - Verify compilation
3. `dotnet test` - Verify test framework setup
tasks.testStrategy: Verify packages are installed correctly through multiple validation steps: 1) Check obj/project.assets.json for package references, 2) Attempt to use SharpCompress and BCnEncoder namespaces in test files, 3) Verify GdUnit4Net test discovery with `dotnet test --list-tests`, 4) Create simple test case to confirm framework integration, 5) Build project without errors using `dotnet build`

tasks.title: Create DMapRenderer Node
tasks.description: Implement the main rendering node that extends Node2D for displaying DMAP content. Implements PRD Phase 4 Rendering System Section 7.1 (lines 273-368) with complete three-layer architecture and isometric coordinate conversion.
tasks.details:
Create DMapRenderer.cs in addons/dmap_importer/Nodes/ following PRD lines 280-367. Extend Node2D and implement comprehensive rendering system:

**Core Structure:**
- LoadFromDMap(DmapFile) method as main entry point
- Three child nodes with Z-index ordering (PRD lines 300-321):
  - backgroundLayer: TileMap (Z:0) for puzzle piece textures
  - terrainLayer: TileMap (Z:1) with custom data for walkability/height/surface
  - objectLayer: Node2D (Z:2) with YSortEnabled for 3D objects

**Coordinate System:**
- Implement Cell2World/World2Cell conversion using CordConverter (PRD lines 103)
- Configure isometric TileMap settings: tile_set.tile_shape = TILE_SHAPE_ISOMETRIC
- Set proper tile offsets and cell sizes for isometric projection

**Layer Configuration:**
- Background: Standard tile rendering with texture mapping
- Terrain: Custom data layers for tile properties (walkable:bool, height:int, surface:enum)
- Objects: Y-sorted 3D sprites with proper depth ordering

**Property System:**
- Implement custom data layers on TileMap resources
- Support runtime property modification through editor dock integration
- Handle tile property persistence and real-time updates

3. Custom data properties correctly assigned to terrain tiles
4. Y-sorting functionality for object layer
5. Performance with larger maps (Game/5017/map/ contains 147 test files)
6. TileMap isometric configuration follows Godot documentation standards

tasks.title: Implement Save/Export Functionality
tasks.description: Add comprehensive bidirectional DMAP file operations to save modified data back to file format, implementing PRD Phase 6 Goals (lines 48-54) for complete save/load functionality with full data preservation and format compliance
tasks.details:
Implement comprehensive save/export functionality for the DmapFile class to enable bidirectional DMAP file operations as specified in PRD Goals Section 2 (lines 48-54). Create robust Save() and Export() methods that preserve all original data structures and format specifications while supporting both compressed (.7z) and uncompressed (.dmap) output formats.

**Core Implementation Requirements:**

1. **DmapFile Export Methods** - Extend DmapFile class with comprehensive export capabilities:
   - Save() method for in-place file updates
   - Export() method for save-as functionality
   - WriteToDmap() method for binary DMAP format writing
   - WriteToArchive() method for .7z compressed output

2. **File Format Preservation** - Maintain complete DMAP format compliance:
   - Preserve original header structure and MapVersion
   - Maintain binary layout compatibility with game client
   - Support all data sections: tiles, portals, covers, scenes, effects, sounds
   - Ensure coordinate system consistency using CordConverter

3. **Archive Creation with SharpCompress** - Replace SevenZipSharp with SharpCompress for output:
   - Use SharpCompress.Writers.SevenZip for .7z creation
   - Implement proper compression settings matching original files
   - Support both compressed and uncompressed output modes
   - Handle archive metadata and file structure preservation

4. **Binary Writing Infrastructure** - Leverage existing BinaryWriterExtensions:
   - Use WriteASCIIString() for string data
   - Utilize Write() overloads for PixelPosition, TilePosition, Size types
   - Implement proper endianness and data alignment
   - Maintain binary compatibility with original file format

5. **Coordinate Conversion Integration** - Ensure proper coordinate transformation:
   - Convert Godot coordinates back to DMAP format using CordConverter
   - Preserve tile positioning and portal coordinates
   - Maintain scene layer positioning accuracy
   - Handle isometric coordinate system conversion

6. **Error Handling & Data Integrity** - Comprehensive validation and error management:
   - Validate data integrity before writing
   - Implement rollback on write failures
   - Verify file completeness after save operations
   - Handle permission and disk space issues gracefully
   - Log detailed error information for debugging

**Implementation Architecture:**
```csharp
public class DmapFile
{
    public void Save() { /* In-place save */ }
    public void Export(string outputPath, bool compress = true) { /* Save-as functionality */ }
    private void WriteToDmap(Stream stream) { /* Binary DMAP writing */ }
    private void WriteToArchive(string path) { /* SharpCompress .7z creation */ }
    private void ValidateDataIntegrity() { /* Pre-save validation */ }
    private void WriteHeader(BinaryWriter writer) { /* Header section */ }
    private void WriteTiles(BinaryWriter writer) { /* Tile data section */ }
    private void WritePortals(BinaryWriter writer) { /* Portal data section */ }
    // Additional write methods for all data sections
}
```

tasks.title: Optimize Rendering Performance
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive performance optimizations for large map rendering based on PRD Phase 7 Optimization requirements with specific performance targets: 60+ FPS rendering, <2 second load time, <500MB memory usage for 1000x1000 tile maps
tasks.details:
Implement comprehensive rendering performance optimization system following PRD Phase 7 Optimization Section 10 (lines 604-618) with strict performance targets:

**Performance Targets (PRD 10.1):**
- Map Loading: < 2 seconds for 1000x1000 tiles
- Rendering: 60+ FPS with full map visible
- Memory Usage: < 500MB for large maps

**Core Optimization Strategies (PRD 10.2):**

1. **Chunk Loading System**: Implement 256x256 tile chunk-based loading for maps larger than 256x256 tiles. Create ChunkManager class to handle dynamic loading/unloading of map chunks based on viewport position. Implement chunk boundaries with seamless transitions.

2. **Texture Atlasing System**: Create TextureAtlas class to combine small textures into larger atlases, reducing draw calls significantly. Implement automatic texture packing algorithm and UV coordinate remapping for tiles and scene objects.

3. **LOD (Level of Detail) System**: Implement distance-based LOD system to reduce detail at distance. Create multiple detail levels for tiles and scene objects based on camera distance. Use simplified meshes/sprites for distant objects.

4. **Object Pooling**: Implement comprehensive object pooling for frequently used sprites, tiles, and scene objects. Create reusable sprite pools to avoid constant instantiation/destruction overhead.

5. **Viewport Culling**: Add viewport culling system to avoid rendering off-screen tiles and objects. Implement frustum culling for camera view optimization.

**Integration Requirements:**
- Integrate with DMapRenderer architecture from Task 5
- Utilize scene object rendering system from Task 13
- Ensure compatibility with Core/ parsing classes from Task 2

**Testing Resources:**
Use Game/5017/map/ directory containing extensive test maps including large maps like 'island.DMap', 'desert.DMap', 'woods.DMap' for performance benchmarking and optimization validation.

**Regression Testing:**
